analysis.reason: 직전 3거래일 연속 관망 유지. RSI 65.5에서 58.1로 하락하며 과매수 구간 냉각 확인. MACD 히스토그램은 566.3852에서 27.8579로 악화되며 약세 지속. 5일 고가 < 20일 고가 * 0.995 패턴으로 Lower High 형성. 현재가 $82,778.9는 스윙 저항선 $82,792.21에 근접하나 돌파하지 못함. 주봉 ADX 43.1로 뚜렷한 추세 유지하나, 일봉상 MACD 약세 지속 및 RSI 중립 구간 횡보로 추가 상승 동력 부족. ATR $2,223.8 대비 손절폭 1.3배($2,891), 목표익절 2.6배($5,783) 설정 시 손익비 1.5 이상 충족 가능. 그러나 명확한 방향성 부재로 관망 유지.
analysis.reasonEn: Previous 3 trading days maintained a wait-and-see stance. RSI declined from 65.5 to 58.1, confirming cooling from overbought territory. MACD histogram worsened from 566.3852 to 27.8579, indicating continued weakness. A Lower High pattern formed as the 5-day high was less than 20-day high * 0.995. The current price of $82,778.9 is near the swing resistance of $82,792.21 but has not broken through. Weekly ADX at 43.1 shows a clear trend, but daily MACD weakness and RSI neutral range sideways suggest insufficient momentum for further upside. With ATR at $2,223.8, a stop loss of 1.3x ($2,891) and target of 2.6x ($5,783) would meet the 1.5 risk-reward ratio. However, due to the lack of clear directional conviction, a wait-and-see approach is maintained.
